_note: Training labels (spec 7.3 steps 1-2), read by `python -m archive.cli load-labels --reviewer <name>`. Only passages from training-cleared items (training_permission allowed; unknown means not allowed). LLM-drafted questions are allowed only after a person reviews them (origin synthetic_reviewed). Hard negatives need a person to confirm each is truly non-relevant; the same text in another edition is not a negative. NOTE: load-labels does not import hard negatives yet. No fine-tuning happens in round one unless the minimum-data gate in backend/archive/datasets/training_gate.json is met.
